title: Spec decomposition
description: The structured output of the first loop: one spec turned into an ordered queue of tickets. The workflow creates one GitHub issue per entry, in `position` order, and the chain then works through them one at a time.

tickets.description: The queue, in build order. Keep it short. A queue longer than about eight is a spec that wanted decomposing into two specs.

position.description: Build order, starting at 1. The chain always takes the lowest open position whose dependencies are closed.

title.description: The issue title. Say what the ticket delivers, not which layer it edits.

body.description: The ticket. Markdown, with a `## What` and a `## Done when` — the second is what the review workflow checks the pull request against, so it has to be checkable from a diff.

shape.description: Same vocabulary the explore verdict uses.

depends_on.description: Positions that must be finished first. Empty means it can be built the moment the queue opens — those are the ones that could run in parallel.
